A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ForeHOI, and their text, equations, tables, and figures are readable. V1 includes supplementary Sections 6–7; v2 contains no corresponding supplement. This is an observable omission from the supplied document, not an extraction gap.

before.justification: V1 reports original reconstruction, pose-estimation, and ablation results in Tables 1–3, plus supplementary qualitative comparisons and hand-alignment results.

after.justification: V2 retains the original HO3D/HOT3D reconstruction results, HO3D pose results, and component ablations in Tables 1–3.

M1.justification: The joint mask/geometry architecture, flow-matching objectives, SLat refinement, and VGGT/PnP pose procedure are retained. Feature-fusion dimensions and the Mast3R/texture explanation clarify existing components. Omission of supplementary alignment details does not establish that the underlying procedure changed.

E1.justification: Synthetic training coverage and the HO3D/HOT3D object-reconstruction and pose tasks remain. V2 removes the dedicated auxiliary HO3D hand-object alignment evaluation reported in v1 Section 7.2 and Figure 6.

E2.justification: The main geometry and pose comparator sets remain unchanged. V2 removes the supplementary comparison with ReconViaGen and Hunyuan3D-3.0, as labeled in v1 Section 7.1/Figure 5, and the separate hand-alignment comparison with MagicHOI.

E3.justification: The reported image-feature grid changes from 47×47 to 37×37 in Section 4.1, and the latent dimensions from 64×64 to 64×64×64 in Section 3.2. These are reported specification revisions, without evidence of rerunning experiments. Main splits, metrics, input lengths, and training budgets remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The dataset, hand-feature, and mask-completion ablations in Table 3/Figure 4 remain unchanged. V2 removes the supplementary qualitative failure analysis examining general generators under hand occlusion and unusual object orientations in Section 7.1/Figure 5.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without repeated-run counts, experimental seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–3 are unchanged, including ForeHOI's HO3D CD of 0.79 cm and HOT3D CD of 1.03 cm. V2 removes supplementary qualitative reconstruction comparisons and the finding of comparable or slightly better hand alignment than MagicHOI in Figures 5–6.

T1.justification: V2 omits the explicit pose projection/smoothness objective and contact/keypoint/temporal alignment objective defined in v1 Equations 4–5. Main Equations 1–3 retain their substance; removing unexplained primes, fixing a bracket, and explaining flow-matching variables do not establish a new derivation.

C1.justification: The abstract and contribution list retain the same feed-forward reconstruction, joint 2D/3D completion, synthetic-dataset, state-of-the-art performance, and approximately 100× speedup claims. The shortened conclusion removes repeated benchmark and visibility wording without changing the paper's overall claimed scope.

C2.justification: Section 3.4 adds symmetry-induced rotational ambiguity as motivation for texture-based pose estimation and attributes Mast3R robustness to data augmentation. V2 removes the explicit limitation concerning generative reconstruction precision, the future pose-integration discussion, and supplementary qualifications about the MagicHOI hand-alignment comparison.

D1.justification: V2 specifies 2048-to-1024 feature fusion through a two-layer MLP and explains flow-matching variables. However, it removes substantial supplementary reproduction information: pose-loss weights, RANSAC frequency, approximately 20-second optimization time, and the contact-alignment procedure and weights. The project-page link disappears while the repository pointer remains. Section 3.4 now references an appendix absent from v2.

R1.justification: The main related-work positioning remains stable. The RANSAC reference by Fischler and Bolles and the SuperGlue reference by Sarlin and colleagues disappear with the supplement; the remaining cited works are retained despite renumbering.

P1.justification: Most main-text prose and section ordering remain intact. Local revisions expand feature-fusion and flow-matching explanations, rewrite the pose-estimation discussion, clarify Table 3, and shorten the conclusion. Affiliations are expanded, acknowledgments are added, and the separate supplementary sections are omitted.

P2.justification: V2 removes three distinct supplementary displays: general-generator reconstruction comparisons, hand-object alignment comparisons, and dataset-diversity illustrations in Figures 5–7. This substantially reduces the visual evidence presented. Main Figures 1–4 and table structures remain, with smaller caption and layout changes, particularly the explanatory Table 3 caption.

improvement.justification: Clearer feature-fusion details, notation, and ablation labels improve readability. These gains are outweighed by losing supplementary comparisons, optimization objectives and hyperparameters, and the explicit precision limitation. The new reference to an absent appendix also impairs completeness. Because the central method and main quantitative validation remain intact, the overall decline is limited.
